snippet.title: Embers of the UncrownedㅣClass Anthology
snippet.description:
Embers of the Uncrowned is a dark fantasy MMORPG
featuring brutal combat, striking visuals, and an immersive world.

⚔️Executioner
A harbinger of massive destruction, who crushes the heart of the battlefield to carve a path.
💫Stormbringer
An emissary of the raging skies, who wields the feat of an uncontrollable storm.
🗡️Spectral Blade
A silent death lingering in afterimages, who annihilates enemies with invisible speed.
※Each class features a set gender in the demo — more options are on the way for launch.

On June 15th, complete your own brutal narrative in Embers of the Uncrowned.

Learn more: 
🎮 Steam Wishlist: https://nexon.link/bpV
💬 Discord: https://nexon.link/bpZ
💌 X : https://nexon.link/bpY
🌐 Official Site: https://nexon.link/bpE
